verdict.rationale: Sentry's own docs cover Python SDK instrumentation (integrations, set_conversation_id(), include_prompts, data_collection options) and the JavaScript/Node SDK (version 11.0.0 auto-instrumentation, recordInputs/recordOutputs), and the homepage describes dropping in the official SDK. Both languages are clearly covered first-party, but the evidence centers on the AI-agent tracing module rather than general app tracing. missing for 10: explicit TypeScript coverage, general (non-AI) tracing instrumentation docs for both SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of Python/JS SDK use

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: As of SDK version `11.0.0`, Sentry auto-instruments the most popular AI SDKs and frameworks out of the box
Your agent will set up Sentry in your Python app automatically.
Use `set_conversation_id()` so every AI span in a chat session shares the same `gen_ai.conversation.id`.
